name: auto-review
description: Tiered review at Stop, sized by the delta since the LAST completed review. Under 40 lines: a self-check. Under 150: one reviewer agent. Above: a parallel bugs + code-quality audit (with the thermos plugin installed; one deep reviewer without it). Every agent round is followed by a critic that issues typed, evidence-bearing verdicts before anything is fixed. Ships the reviewer, thermo-bugs, thermo-quality, critic, adversary and worker agents and their rubrics.
